name: 河流与湖泊
Rivers and lakes
note: r18 水文（runs/_hydro/r18-20260928）：2 km 汇流，径流取 clim-r18 代理气候，湖取水深 > 1 m，含 Skyleaf 融水（冰川 1,408 km²，年均约 47 m³/s）；不是气候阶段结果。

r18 hydrology (runs/_hydro/r18-20260928): 2 km routing of clim-r18 proxy runoff, lakes deeper than 1 m, Skyleaf meltwater included (1,408 km² of glacier, about 47 m³/s annual mean); not a climate-stage result.

name: 干湿带
Aridity
note: AI = 年降水 / 潜在蒸散，8 km 代理气候，UNEP 分级。试验：依赖锁里的气候、水文、干湿带、植被、聚落、航线阶段都还没有验收，这里是工作底本，不是阶段结果。

AI = P / PET of the 8 km climate proxy, UNEP classes. Experiment: no climate, hydrology, aridity, vegetation, settlement or route stage is accepted in the dependency lock; this is the working state, not a stage result.

name: 降水 · 年平均
Annual precipitation
note: 8 km 代理气候的年降水（地球年）。试验：依赖锁里的气候、水文、干湿带、植被、聚落、航线阶段都还没有验收，这里是工作底本，不是阶段结果。

Annual precipitation of the 8 km climate proxy (Earth year). Experiment: no climate, hydrology, aridity, vegetation, settlement or route stage is accepted in the dependency lock; this is the working state, not a stage result.

name: 风场 · 年平均近地面
Wind · annual surface
note: 全球两层谱模式（T42）的年平均近地面风；Aethelgard 图在区内用 8 km 降尺度。试验：依赖锁里的气候、水文、干湿带、植被、聚落、航线阶段都还没有验收，这里是工作底本，不是阶段结果。

Annual-mean surface wind of the global two-layer spectral run (T42); the Aethelgard view uses the 8 km downscale inside the region. Experiment: no climate, hydrology, aridity, vegetation, settlement or route stage is accepted in the dependency lock; this is the working state, not a stage result.

Vegetation · Y521

Eco vegetation at Y521 (CI spread, growth x 2.5). Experiment: no climate, hydrology, aridity, vegetation, settlement or route stage is accepted in the dependency lock; this is the working state, not a stage result.

name: 住地五级 · Y521
Settlements · five tiers · Y521
note: 住地五级（src/eco/tiers_run.py）：按 canon 处数与人口在 8 km 格上分配的制图工作值。Aethelgard：地形 p30（T108，Skyleaf v3）；气候代理 clim-r18（wind-r18）；水文 r18；生态 g-s8p30；住地五级 / I–V 级航线 aeth-r18；Vorhan–Duskreach：地形 v14（T102）；气候代理 clim-r18；水文 r18；生态 vd18replay-s11（工作底本 vd12R7v-s11 的重放）；住地五级 / I–V 级航线 vd-r18；Keld：地形 p7（T100）；气候代理 clim-r18；水文 r18；生态 keld-s8p7w18；住地五级 / I–V 级航线 keld-r18。试验：依赖锁里的气候、水文、干湿带、植被、聚落、航线阶段都还没有验收，这里是工作底本，不是阶段结果。

Five settlement tiers (src/eco/tiers_run.py): cartographic working values placed on the 8 km grid by canon counts and populations. Experiment: no climate, hydrology, aridity, vegetation, settlement or route stage is accepted in the dependency lock; this is the working state, not a stage result.

name: 航线 · I–V 级
Routes · classes I–V
note: I–V 级飞艇航线（满载最短时路径，年均巡航风；线宽 ∝ 流量）。试验：依赖锁里的气候、水文、干湿带、植被、聚落、航线阶段都还没有验收，这里是工作底本，不是阶段结果。

Airship routes of classes I–V (loaded least-time paths, annual cruise wind; width ~ flow). Experiment: no climate, hydrology, aridity, vegetation, settlement or route stage is accepted in the dependency lock; this is the working state, not a stage result.

name: 曲率密度审核
Curvature audit
note: 红：比设定的地形下限更平滑（需要加细节）；紫：比地球同高程更粗糙或更均一（terrain-forge/reference）。2 km 审核（src/audit_stack.py），p30 / p7 / v14；Axiom、盐沼、保护锚点按设计豁免。

Red: smoother than the set floor (needs detail); violet: rougher or more uniform than Earth at the same elevation. 2 km audit (src/audit_stack.py) of p30 / p7 / v14; Axiom, salt pans and protected anchors exempt by design.
